WOW! WHAT AN INCREDIBLE DAY, BERMUDA!
I’m still smiling this morning thinking about yesterday’s amazing Pokémon & Collectibles Show at Washington Mall in the heart of Hamilton!
From the moment we opened at 10 a.m. until we closed at 4 p.m., the place was absolutely buzzing! What a fantastic turnout!
But you know what made the day so special for me? THE CHILDREN!

Seeing so many excited young collectors arriving with their parents and grandparents, looking through Pokémon cards, sharing their collections, asking questions and simply enjoying themselves was absolutely wonderful!

And of course, it was equally enjoyable catching up with so many adult collectors, including people who remembered visiting my old Upper Deck Sports Cards & Collectibles shop more than 30 years ago! What wonderful memories!
A huge thank-you to everyone who came out and supported the show, and to all my fellow vendors. What a fantastic group of people! I think we can all agree that yesterday was something special.
And a very special thank-you to Mark of Bermy Cards who had the original vision of bringing a dedicated Pokémon show to Bermuda. Mark, you certainly started something wonderful, mate!
Thank you as well to Washington Mall and the Washington Properties team for welcoming us into such a fantastic location.
And I certainly couldn’t have done it without Lot and everyone who helped me throughout the day. Much love and appreciation to you all!
The photographs really tell the story, so I’ll let them do plenty of the talking!
Now, here’s some exciting news! We’re already looking ahead to our next show in February 2027, and discussions are underway about future events in the new year. So stay tuned!
And I’ve got a couple of exciting announcements of my own coming very soon, so keep following my page. There’s plenty more to come!
Thank you once again, Bermuda, for making yesterday such a memorable day. It was an absolute pleasure meeting so many wonderful people, young and old.
Happy ripping, happy collecting, and much love to you all!
